# Purdue Hackers Events

> events.purduehackers.com — the events site of Purdue Hackers, a community of
> students who build cool things together. Weekly Hack Nights (Fridays 8pm ET,
> Bechtel Center), workshops, and shows, archived with photos back to Spring 2022.
> All events are free. No accounts, no tracking.

## Feeds

- Calendar (iCal): webcal://events.purduehackers.com/api/events.ics
- RSS: https://events.purduehackers.com/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://events.purduehackers.com/sitemap.xml

## Pages

- Event pages live at /events/<category>/<slug> (categories: hack-night, workshop, show, and friends)
- The home page lists upcoming and past events, grouped by academic semester

## Source

- Open source: https://github.com/purduehackers/events
- The rest of us: https://purduehackers.com
